_comment: digit-lts issuers config for Mimoto. REPLACES the upstream file, which is
not usable here: it shipped 7 demo issuers (MosipOtp, Mosip, StayProtected,
Mock, MosipTAN, Land, MockMdl), every one of them pointing at MOSIP's own
sandbox hosts, and referencing 12 placeholders that nothing in this config
esignet.host, mosip.injicertify.mosipid.host and so on. Mimoto would have
served a wallet listing seven issuers it cannot reach.
More importantly all 7 used redirect_uri io.mosip.residentapp.inji://
oauthredirect -- an Android/iOS deep link for the MOBILE wallet. The web
wallet needs an https redirect back to injiweb, so none of them would have
completed an authorization round trip in a browser.
The upstream file is preserved at mimoto-issuers-config.json.upstream for
diffing on an Inji version bump.

_comment_client_id: Must match a client REGISTERED WITH eSIGNET. Registration is a separate
step against eSignet's client-management API and has not been done yet;
until it is, the authorization request is rejected with invalid_client.
The public key registered there must be the one in oidckeystore.p12
_comment_wellknown: Certify serves issuer metadata under its servlet path. Kept in the
host root: the host-root form is what a WALLET discovers via the
credential offer, while this field is the explicit endpoint Mimoto
fetches. Verify against the running service and correct if it 404s.
_comment_redirect: https back to the web wallet, NOT the mobile deep link every upstream
issuer used. This is the change that makes the browser flow work.
_comment_token: token_endpoint is Mimoto's own proxy, reached same-origin through
injiweb's nginx (/v1/mimoto -> mimoto-service). It is deliberately NOT
on a Mimoto hostname, because Mimoto has no Ingress in the web-wallet
